missions.briefing:
Travel to Liverpool refinery in Newcastle system and deliver Sandoval’s cargo of Iron.

Pays 15000 credits.

Return to New Detroit to receive pay in exchange for alien artifact.

Take cargo of plastics from New Detroit to Oakham pirate base in the Pentonville system.

Pays 10000 credits.

Tayla will be waiting for you there to give you your next mission.

Take cargo of Brilliance to Hector mining base in the Troy system.

Pays 15000 credits.

Return to Oakham pirate base in the Pentonville system for Tayla’s next mission.

Take a shipment of Brilliance to base New Constantinople.

Pays 20000 credits.

Return to Oakham pirate base in the Pentonville system for Tayla’s next mission.

Take a second shipment of Brilliance to base New Constantinople.

Pays 10000 credits.

Return to Oakham pirate base for payment and more information about the artifact.

Deliver a message to Seelig from Roman Lynch. Seelig is at Nav 2 in the Pentonville system.

Pays 10000 credits.

Take a shipment of weapons from base New Constantinople to Rikel system, Siva agricultural planet for Lynch.

Pays 15000 credits.

Smuggle Lynch’s cousin Regis from New Constantinople to Castor system, Romulus mining base.

Pays 30000 credits.

Collect Lynch’s researcher from Newcastle system, Liverpool refinery base.

Pays 30000 credits.

Meet with Hunter Toth’s ship at Oxford system, Nav 3 and escort him safely to Oxford.

Pays 10000 credits.

Search Oxford system for the pirate ship Rhombus and destroy it.

Pays 10000 credits.

Meet with the ship Vulcan’s Forge, at Oxford system, Nav 3, and escort it safely to Oxford.

Pays 10000 credits.

Meet with the University supply ship at Oxford system, Nav 1 and escort it safely to Oxford.

Pays 10000 credits.

Intercept reinforcements at Palan system, Nav 1 and destroy them.

Pays 15000 credits.

Locate and intercept patrol at Nav 1 or Nav 2 in Palan system. Engage and destroy the patrol.

Pays 10000 credits.

Attack the remaining blockade at Palan system, Nav 4.

Break through and land on planet Palan and meet Dr Monkhouse there in the bar.

Pays 15000 credits.

Transport Dr Monkhouse to Basra refinery.

After landing on Basra, meet Dr Monkhouse in the bar for his analysis of the artifact.

Pays 5000 credits.

Travel to Delta system and map sector by hitting 4 nav points pre-programmed into your ship’s nav computer.

Pays 10000 credits.

Go to system Delta and jump to the uncharted system designated Beta. Hit all the nav points entered in your nav computer.

If you can, find Captain Garrovick.

Pays 10000 credits.

Pass through Beta system and jump into the uncharted Gamma system. Fly the loop pattern in your nav computer, hitting each nav point in sequence.

Pays 10000 credits.

Map newly discovered system Delta Prime. Jump to Delta Prime from Gamma system. Hit the nav point programmed into your nav computer.

Pays 10000 credits.
Travel to Perry Naval Base and meet with Admiral Terrell to discuss the mysterious series of disappearing and destroyed ships that have been found in the wake of your movements.

Travel to Blockade Point Tango, Nav 3, meet with Commodore Reismann there, and draw the suspected Kilrathi marauder into a Confederation ambush.

Pays 30000 credits.

Take cargo of personal goods from Oakham pirate base to Tuck’s in the Sherwood system.

Pays 10000 credits.

Tayla will be waiting for you there to give you your next mission.

Take cargo of Brilliance from Tuck’s to Saratov mining base in the Prasepe system.

Pays 20000 credits.

Take load of Brilliance from Tuck’s to Speke in Junction system.

Pays 30000 credits.

Deliver Brilliance from Tuck’s to Basque in Pyrenees System.

Pays 40000 credits.

Patrol 44-P-1M system for pirate and Retro activity.

Pays 10000 credits.

Take cargo of construction and ore supplies to Liverpool in the Newcastle system.

Pays 20000 credits.

Take cargo of generic and luxury foods to New Detroit in the New Detroit system.

Pays 30000 credits.

Patrol the Metsor system eliminating any hostile presence in the system.

Pays 50000 credits.

Defend Nitir, an agricultural base in the Nitir system.

Pays 10000 credits.

Defend Charon, a mining base in the Hyades System from Kilrathi attacks.

Pays 10000 credits.

Patrol New Caledonia system for Kilrathi presence.

 Pays 10000 credits.

Patrol the Regallis system for Kilrathi presence.

Pays 10000 credits.

Take cargo of research materials from Oxford to base Edom in the New Constantinople system.

Pays 10000 credits.

Return to Masterson at Oxford for next mission.

Patrol Oxford system and destroy all pirates and Retros.

Pays 10000 credits.

Take cargo of rare books from Oxford to base Burton in the Junction system.

Pays 10000 credits.

Return to Masterson at Oxford for next mission.

Meet with the equipment transport at Oxford system, Nav 4, and escort it safely to jump point at Oxford Nav 1.

Pays 10000 credits.

Take cargo of artwork from Oxford to Perry Naval Base in the Perry system.

Pays 10000 credits.

Return to Masterson at Oxford

Transport Monte to New Detroit base.

After landing on New Detroit, meet Monte in the bar for further information.

Retrieve documents for Monte. Fly to Drake base in the Capella system.

See contact in the bar on Drake base for further information.
Deliver documents to Monte at New Detroit base in New Detroit system.

Intercept Retro Patrol at Nexus system, Nav 4 and destroy them.

Pays 5000 credits.

Bounty offered for the eradication of Menesch from Gemini Sector.

Search Troy and surrounding systems.

Travel to Blockade Point Alpha, Nav 1, meet with Commodore Uhler, and wait for further instructions.

Pays 20000 credits.

Patrol the Death, Pestilence and War systems, and destroy any Retro presence.

Pays 20000 credits.

Return to Admiral Terrell at Perry Naval Base.

Bounty offered for the eradication of Jones from Gemini Sector.

Search Valhalla for jump to Eden. Proceed to Retro base in Eden.

Bounty offered for the eradication of Jones from Gemini Sector. Locate Jones in Eden system.

Pays 80000 credits.
